concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-mail-and-telephone-order-moto]] — Adyen Docs website guide to card-not-present MOTO tender-option payments keyed on a terminal, standalone/Terminal API scope, AVS, PCI and liability limits (2026-09-15 snapshot).
warnings: MOTO is card-not-present despite use of a terminal; do not present it as a card-present or ordinary online Checkout flow.
AVS mismatch can coexist with issuer authorization; cancellation of a MOTO authorization is documented as SentForRefund.
